turns.q: And if I change my mind, how easy is it to return?
turns.replyText:
Returns are pretty straightforward as long as the items are unworn and unused, in original/new condition with tags attached, and returned within 30 days of delivery.

You can start a return here: [Fashion Nova Returns Portal](https://returns.fashionnova.com/fashionnova/returns). Approved returns are issued as store credit via an e-gift card.
